status_semantics.not-applicable: The optimization family is scientifically or architecturally out of scope for this method/backend cell.
status_semantics.unverified: Applicability or consumer adoption has not been established; no production claim is allowed.
status_semantics.represented: A shared compiler/schedule/runtime owner can express the mechanism; this does not claim a method consumer is wired.
status_semantics.wired: A method consumer invokes the mechanism, but production selection and complete-endpoint qualification are not claimed.
status_semantics.production: The mechanism is eligible on a production path with method-level correctness evidence; benchmark non-regression is not implied.
status_semantics.benchmark-qualified: The production path has retained complete-endpoint non-regression evidence with an explicit regression budget.
